note: StageCraft — a 20-foot high 270-degree semicircular LED wall and ceiling around a 75-foot performance space. Over half of The Mandalorian season one was shot this way, capturing complex VFX in-camera through a real-time engine rather than in post.

The consequence of the volume that matters for grammar: the displayed environment is itself the practical source lighting the actor, so light direction and background geometry are pinned together by construction rather than by continuity discipline.
